name: Phlebotomy
description: Drawing blood — by vacuum tube, syringe or butterfly — confirming patient identity, collecting and labelling specimens, and getting them to the laboratory intact. ⚠⚠⚠ The shortest credential Florida awards in health care: of 772 phlebotomy credentials issued by 29 public institutions in 2023, EVERY SINGLE ONE was a certificate of under twelve weeks. ⚠ No Florida licence is required — the clinical laboratory licensing statute names phlebotomists in its EXCLUSION.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ UNDER TWELVE WEEKS, WITHOUT EXCEPTION. IPEDS records 772 Florida phlebotomy credentials in the 2023 award year across 29 public institutions, and the award level on all 772 is Certificate (less than 12 weeks). No associate degree, no longer certificate, nothing. It is the shortest formal route into health care the state operates, and 24 of the 29 carriers are DISTRICT TECHNICAL COLLEGES. ⚠⚠ In the Florida course file the training is two blocks: HSC0003 Basic Healthcare Worker, 90 hours, the shared core of Florida health-science CTE and the most widely carried course in the state at 55 institutions; then MEA0520 Phlebotomist (OCP B, 75 hours, 20 institutions) or MEA0521 Phlebotomist, MA (OCP C, 75 hours, 22 institutions). ⚠ About 165 clock hours end to end. ⚠⚠ Note where those course numbers come from: phlebotomy is an OCCUPATIONAL COMPLETION POINT inside Florida's Medical Assisting programme, so the same 75 hours can either be a standalone certificate or the second rung of a longer programme. Ask which your institution is enrolling you in, because continuing to medical assistant afterwards is much easier if you started inside that programme. ⚠ And ask whether the programme prepares you for a NATIONAL certification exam. Florida requires none, but hospitals and reference laboratories screen on ASCP PBT, NHA CPT or AMT RPT, and a programme that does not end in an exam leaves you competing without the thing employers filter on.

cips.note: Phlebotomy Technician/Phlebotomist — 29 Florida public institutions and 772 credentials in 2023, ⚠ every one of them a certificate of under twelve weeks. Largest carriers: Osceola Technical College 82, Traviss Technical College 72, Miami Dade College 68, Lake Technical College 54. 24 of the 29 are district technical colleges.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The rung above, and the reason to think of phlebotomy as a beginning rather than a destination. The laboratory ladder runs phlebotomist ($45,230) to medical laboratory technician ($62,930) to medical laboratory scientist ($82,280) — but Florida teaches the technician at only 9 institutions and the scientist at 5, against 29 for phlebotomy. ⚠ The higher rungs pay far better and are far harder to get into, and both are STATE LICENSED where phlebotomy is not.

⚠⚠⚠ Not a neighbour — the SAME PROGRAMME. Phlebotomy is occupational completion point B and C of Florida's Medical Assisting framework, and MEA0520 and MEA0521 are the courses. So a phlebotomy certificate is literally a partial medical assisting credential, and continuing costs only the remaining OCPs (EKG aide at 75 hours, then medical assistant at 960). ⚠ Ask your institution whether it will count what you have already done.

⚠ Not a route — separate credential, clock hours do not transfer into a credit degree. Named because phlebotomy is the cheapest and fastest way to find out whether you can work with patients, needles and blood before committing two years to nursing. ⚠⚠ Under twelve weeks to answer that question is worth something, and the job pays while you decide.
